nodes.summary: Chargebee is a comprehensive subscription management and recurring billing platform that helps businesses automate their revenue operations. It offers a range of features including usage-based pricing, customer retention, revenue recognition, and various integrations. It allows businesses to launch a subscription model, experiment with pricing, serve customers worldwide, and manage customer churn.

nodes.name: Subscription Management
nodes.description: Allows businesses to manage and automate their subscription billing processes.

nodes.name: Usage-based Pricing
nodes.description: Enables businesses to set pricing based on the usage of their product or service.

nodes.name: Customer Retention
nodes.description: Predicts churn, deflects cancellation attempts, and helps grow customer lifetime value.

nodes.name: Revenue Recognition
nodes.description: Helps businesses recognize revenue accurately and be GAAP-compliant and audit ready.

nodes.name: Integration Capabilities
nodes.description: Offers 60+ integrations and 30+ payment gateways to streamline business operations.

nodes.name: Global Service
nodes.description: Enables businesses to serve customers worldwide, supporting global growth.

nodes.name: Churn Management
nodes.description: Provides tools to manage and reduce customer churn, improving customer retention.

nodes.name: Pricing Experimentation
nodes.description: Allows businesses to experiment with different pricing models to optimize revenue.
